title: kaijutsu swarm.yaml (user-defined preset SDK)
description: Schema for .kaijutsu/swarm.yaml (per-project) and ~/.kaijutsu/swarm.yaml (per-user). Each entry defines a custom swarm preset that becomes a `jutsu swarm <name>` cobra subcommand at root construction. v0.13.0+. Spec: docs/specs/2026-05-08-v0.13.0-preset-sdk.md.

name.description: Subcommand name. Lowercase, no whitespace, alphanumeric + hyphens. Must NOT collide with a built-in preset (pr-review, doc-review, brainstorm, dream, refactor-plan, security-audit, reverse, test-gap, bug-repro, code-archaeology). Collision is a hard validation error per spec Decision #2.

inputKind.description: Dispatch shape. `diff` reuses --pr/--diff-from-branch flags; `files` takes positional paths; `prompt` takes a positional free-form prompt. v0.13 supports only these 3 (no custom auxiliary input plumbing per spec Decision #3).

defaultPrompt.description: Per-agent prompt template. MUST contain exactly one literal `%s` slot — the cobra layer substitutes the input body via fmt.Sprintf at dispatch time. Validation rejects 0 or 2+ slots.

synthesizer.description: Synthesizer prompt template. MUST contain exactly one literal `%s` slot — substituted with the per-agent findings JSON. Validation rejects 0 or 2+ slots.

severityVocab.description: Severity values valid for this preset. Each MUST match an existing swarm.Severity constant. v0.13 does NOT allow custom severity strings — pick from the predefined set used by built-in presets.

mode.description: Default swarm mode. `quick` (default) runs Pass-1 + synthesis. `full` adds Pass-2 round-robin debate via `genericDebateTemplate`.

personas.description: Persona names to dispatch (resolved against agents.yaml). Empty = legacy auto-detect (claude/codex/gemini). Unknown persona name → cobra error at command time per the v0.10.1 enum-rejection format.

confidenceFloor.description: Drop synthesized findings below this confidence before clustering. 0.30 matches reverse/test-gap/bug-repro/code-archaeology defaults; 0.55 matches pr-review default.
